# Import libraries
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Removing the Material_ID column
remove_ids = df.columns[0]
test_results = df.drop(remove_ids,axis=1)
print(test_results.head(),'\n')
Tmin = test_results.min(axis=0).min(axis = 0)
Tmax = test_results.max(axis=0).max(axis = 0)
Truelabel = test_results.columns[0]
PredictLabel = test_results.columns[1]

# Visuallizing the CGCNN model performance

fig = plt.figure()
axis = fig.add_axes([0.1,0.1,1.5,1.5])

axis.set_xlim(Tmin,Tmax)
axis.set_ylim(Tmin,Tmax)
x1 = np.linspace(*axis.get_xlim()) # generates 45 degree angle
axis.plot(x1, x1)  # add 45-deg line
axis.plot(Truelabel,PredictLabel,marker ='o',linestyle = 'none', color ='red', markersize = 10)
axis.set_title('Parity Plot',fontsize = 20)
axis.set_xlabel("True Labels",fontsize = 20)
axis.set_ylabel("Predicted Labels",fontsize = 20)
